change: FilesPaneService now reopens a stamped row on its worker and calls DirectoryCursor::retire_child with the observed identity.
The Files app exposes a separate Delete permanently command and irreversible confirmation dialog, with navigation and row revalidation before submission.
No pathname unlink/stat fallback, Trash/Recycling fallback, directory recursion, or POSIX/macOS capability claim was added.
